import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion, useReducedMotionConfig } from 'motion/react'
import {
  type ChangeEvent,
  type ClipboardEvent,
  type DragEvent,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/** OS setting, or forced on with <MotionConfig reducedMotion="always">. */
function usePrefersReducedMotion() {
  const os = useReducedMotion()
  const forced = useReducedMotionConfig()
  return Boolean(os || forced)
}

export interface FileError {
  message: string
  code: string
}

export interface UploadHelpers {
  /** Report upload progress from 0 to 100. */
  onProgress: (percent: number) => void
  /** Aborted when the row is removed or the component unmounts. */
  signal: AbortSignal
}

export interface FileUploadProps {
  /**
   * Uploads one file. Called once per file, a few at a time. Resolve to mark the row done, reject
   * to show the error with a Retry button. When omitted, uploads are simulated locally over
   * `uploadDelay` and nothing leaves the browser.
   */
  onUpload?: (file: File, helpers: UploadHelpers) => Promise<void>
  /** Called when one file finishes uploading. */
  onUploadSuccess?: (file: File) => void
  /** Called for validation errors and failed uploads. */
  onUploadError?: (error: FileError, file: File) => void
  /** Called with every uploaded file once nothing is queued or in flight. */
  onComplete?: (files: File[]) => void
  /** Called when a row is removed (cancelling its upload if needed). */
  onFileRemove?: (file: File) => void
  /** MIME types ("image/png"), wildcards ("image/*") or extensions (".pdf"). */
  acceptedFileTypes?: string[]
  /** Maximum size of each file in bytes. Defaults to 5 MB. */
  maxFileSize?: number
  /** Accept several files at once. */
  multiple?: boolean
  /** Maximum number of files in the list. */
  maxFiles?: number
  /** Simulated upload duration per file in ms, used without `onUpload`. Set 0 to finish at once. */
  uploadDelay?: number
  /** Simulated uploads only: the first attempt of every third file fails, so Retry can be seen. */
  simulateFailure?: boolean
  /** Extra validation. Return an error to reject the file. */
  validateFile?: (file: File) => FileError | null
  className?: string
}

type ItemStatus = 'queued' | 'uploading' | 'done' | 'error' | 'rejected'

interface QueueItem {
  id: string
  file: File
  index: number
  status: ItemStatus
  progress: number
  attempts: number
  error?: FileError
  previewUrl?: string
}

const DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024
const CONCURRENCY = 3
const SIMULATED_TICK = 80
const EASE_OUT = [0.23, 1, 0.32, 1] as const
const FILE_SIZES = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'] as const
// Module constant, so the default does not change identity every render.
const NO_ACCEPTED_TYPES: string[] = []

const formatBytes = (bytes: number): string => {
  if (!bytes) return '0 B'
  const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), FILE_SIZES.length - 1)
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** i
  return `${value >= 10 || i === 0 ? Math.round(value) : Number(value.toFixed(1))} ${FILE_SIZES[i]}`
}

// Accepts exact MIME types ("image/png"), wildcards ("image/*") and extensions (".pdf"), like the
// input's `accept` attribute.
const matchesAcceptedType = (file: File, acceptedType: string): boolean => {
  const accepted = acceptedType.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!accepted) return false
  if (accepted.startsWith('.')) return file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(accepted)
  const fileType = file.type.toLowerCase()
  if (accepted.endsWith('/*')) return fileType.startsWith(accepted.slice(0, -1))
  return fileType === accepted
}

// ".pdf" -> "PDF", "image/svg+xml" -> "SVG", "image/*" -> "images".
const describeAcceptedType = (acceptedType: string): string => {
  const accepted = acceptedType.trim()
  if (accepted.startsWith('.')) return accepted.slice(1).toUpperCase()
  const [kind = '', subtype = ''] = accepted.split('/')
  if (subtype === '*') return `${kind.toLowerCase()}s`
  return subtype.split('+')[0].toUpperCase()
}

const describeAcceptedTypes = (acceptedTypes: string[]): string => {
  const labels = acceptedTypes.map(describeAcceptedType).filter(Boolean)
  if (!labels.length) return 'Any file'
  const text = labels.length > 1 ? `${labels.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} or ${labels.at(-1)}` : labels[0]
  return text.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + text.slice(1)
}

const extensionOf = (name: string): string => {
  const dot = name.lastIndexOf('.')
  if (dot <= 0 || dot === name.length - 1) return 'FILE'
  return name.slice(dot + 1).slice(0, 4).toUpperCase()
}

const clampProgress = (value: number) => Math.min(Math.max(value, 0), 100)

const isFileDrag = (e: { dataTransfer: DataTransfer | null }) => Boolean(e.dataTransfer?.types?.includes('Files'))

const countDraggedFiles = (dataTransfer: DataTransfer): number => {
  let count = 0
  for (const item of Array.from(dataTransfer.items ?? [])) {
    if (item.kind === 'file') count += 1
  }
  return count
}

// Default upload: advances in uneven steps, like a real network would. Runs entirely in the browser.
const simulateUpload = (
  { onProgress, signal }: UploadHelpers,
  duration: number,
  shouldFail: boolean,
): Promise<void> =>
  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (duration <= 0) {
      resolve()
      return
    }
    let progress = 0
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      progress = Math.min(progress + (100 * SIMULATED_TICK * (0.4 + Math.random() * 1.2)) / duration, 100)
      if (shouldFail && progress >= 58) {
        clearInterval(interval)
        reject(new Error('Connection lost'))
        return
      }
      onProgress(progress)
      if (progress >= 100) {
        clearInterval(interval)
        resolve()
      }
    }, SIMULATED_TICK)
    signal.addEventListener(
      'abort',
      () => {
        clearInterval(interval)
        reject(new DOMException('Upload cancelled', 'AbortError'))
      },
      { once: true },
    )
  })

const buildItems = (
  files: File[],
  {
    room,
    validate,
    nextId,
  }: {
    room: number
    validate: (file: File) => FileError | null
    nextId: () => { id: string; index: number }
  },
) => {
  const added: QueueItem[] = []
  let accepted = 0
  let skipped = 0
  for (const file of files) {
    const error = validate(file) ?? undefined
    if (!error && accepted >= room) {
      skipped += 1
      continue
    }
    if (!error) accepted += 1
    const { id, index } = nextId()
    added.push({
      id,
      file,
      index,
      status: error ? 'rejected' : 'queued',
      progress: 0,
      attempts: 0,
      error,
      previewUrl: !error && file.type.startsWith('image/') ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : undefined,
    })
  }
  return { added, skipped }
}

const summarize = (items: QueueItem[]) => {
  let done = 0
  let failed = 0
  let busy = false
  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.status === 'done') done += 1
    else if (item.status === 'error' || item.status === 'rejected') failed += 1
    else busy = true
  }
  return { done, failed, busy }
}

const zoneCopy = ({
  isFull,
  overZone,
  windowDrag,
  multiple,
  limit,
  maxFileSize,
  acceptedFileTypes,
}: {
  isFull: boolean
  overZone: number
  windowDrag: boolean
  multiple: boolean
  limit: number
  maxFileSize: number
  acceptedFileTypes: string[]
}) => {
  const noun = multiple ? 'files' : 'a file'
  if (isFull) return { title: 'File limit reached', showBrowse: false, hint: 'Remove a file to add another' }
  const sizeHint = maxFileSize > 0 && Number.isFinite(maxFileSize) ? ` up to ${formatBytes(maxFileSize)}` : ''
  const hint = `${describeAcceptedTypes(acceptedFileTypes)}${sizeHint}${multiple ? ` · ${limit} max` : ''}`
  if (overZone) {
    return { title: `Release to add ${overZone} ${overZone === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}`, showBrowse: false, hint }
  }
  if (windowDrag) return { title: `Drop ${noun} here`, showBrowse: false, hint }
  return { title: `Drop ${noun} here or `, showBrowse: true, hint }
}

const statusLine = (item: QueueItem): string => {
  switch (item.status) {
    case 'queued':
      return 'Waiting'
    case 'uploading':
      return `${Math.round(item.progress)}%`
    case 'done':
      return 'Uploaded'
    case 'error':
    case 'rejected':
      return item.error?.message ?? 'Upload failed'
    default:
      return ''
  }
}

const svgProps = {
  'aria-hidden': true,
  fill: 'none',
  stroke: 'currentColor',
  strokeLinecap: 'round',
  strokeLinejoin: 'round',
} as const

function UploadIcon({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg {...svgProps} viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth="2" className={className}>
      <path d="M12 16V4m0 0L7 9m5-5 5 5M4 16v3a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h14a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-3" />
    </svg>
  )
}

function CloseIcon({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg {...svgProps} viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth="2" className={className}>
      <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18" />
    </svg>
  )
}

function RetryIcon({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg {...svgProps} viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth="2" className={className}>
      <path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-3-6.7M21 4v5h-5" />
    </svg>
  )
}

function FileThumb({ item }: { item: QueueItem }) {
  if (item.previewUrl) {
    return (
      <span
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="size-9 shrink-0 rounded-md bg-muted bg-cover bg-center ring-1 ring-border ring-inset"
        style={{ backgroundImage: `url("${item.previewUrl}")` }}
      />
    )
  }
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className="flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-border bg-muted font-mono text-[9px] font-medium tracking-wide text-muted-foreground"
    >
      {extensionOf(item.file.name)}
    </span>
  )
}

function DoneCheck({ reduced }: { reduced: boolean }) {
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 text-success" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 16 16">
      <motion.path
        d="M3.5 8.5 6.5 11.5 12.5 4.5"
        initial={{ pathLength: reduced ? 1 : 0 }}
        animate={{ pathLength: 1 }}
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeLinecap="round"
        strokeLinejoin="round"
        strokeWidth="1.75"
        transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.32, ease: EASE_OUT, delay: 0.05 }}
      />
    </svg>
  )
}

const iconButton =
  'flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground outline-none transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring active:bg-accent'

function QueueRow({
  item,
  reduced,
  onRemove,
  onRetry,
}: {
  item: QueueItem
  reduced: boolean
  onRemove: (id: string) => void
  onRetry: (id: string) => void
}) {
  const failed = item.status === 'error' || item.status === 'rejected'
  const inFlight = item.status === 'uploading' || item.status === 'queued'
  const name = item.file.name

  return (
    <motion.li
      className="overflow-hidden"
      initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
      exit={{
        height: 0,
        opacity: 0,
        transition: {
          height: { duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.2, ease: EASE_OUT },
          opacity: { duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.12, ease: EASE_OUT },
        },
      }}
      transition={{
        height: reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { type: 'spring', duration: 0.35, bounce: 0 },
        opacity: reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE_OUT, delay: 0.05 },
      }}
    >
      <div className="relative flex items-center gap-3 px-1 py-2.5">
        <FileThumb item={item} />

        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="truncate text-[13px] leading-5 font-medium">{name}</p>
          <p className={cn('truncate text-xs leading-4 tabular-nums', failed ? 'text-destructive' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
            <span>{formatBytes(item.file.size)}</span>
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="px-1 text-border">
              ·
            </span>
            {statusLine(item)}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
          {item.status === 'done' && (
            <span className="flex size-7 items-center justify-center">
              <DoneCheck reduced={reduced} />
            </span>
          )}
          {item.status === 'error' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={`Retry ${name}`}
              className={cn(iconButton, 'w-auto gap-1 px-2 text-xs')}
              onClick={() => onRetry(item.id)}
            >
              <RetryIcon className="size-3" />
              Retry
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label={inFlight ? `Cancel ${name}` : `Remove ${name}`}
            className={iconButton}
            onClick={() => onRemove(item.id)}
          >
            <CloseIcon className="size-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* The row's hairline divider doubles as its progress bar. */}
        <div className="absolute inset-x-1 bottom-0 h-px bg-border">
          <div
            role="progressbar"
            aria-label={`Uploading ${name}`}
            aria-valuemin={0}
            aria-valuemax={100}
            aria-valuenow={Math.round(item.progress)}
            className={cn(
              'h-full origin-left',
              !reduced && 'transition-[transform,opacity,background-color] duration-200 ease-linear',
              // A retry starts from zero at once instead of rewinding.
              item.progress === 0 && 'transition-none',
              item.status === 'done' && cn('bg-success opacity-0', !reduced && 'delay-300 duration-300 ease-out'),
              failed && 'bg-destructive',
              inFlight && 'bg-foreground',
            )}
            style={{ transform: `scaleX(${item.progress / 100})` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.li>
  )
}

/**
 * A drop zone with a queue: drop, paste or browse for files, watch each upload, retry failures.
 * Uploads are simulated in the browser unless you pass `onUpload`.
 */
export function FileUpload({
  onUpload,
  onUploadSuccess,
  onUploadError,
  onComplete,
  onFileRemove,
  acceptedFileTypes = NO_ACCEPTED_TYPES,
  maxFileSize = DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE,
  multiple = true,
  maxFiles = 5,
  uploadDelay = 2000,
  simulateFailure = false,
  validateFile,
  className,
}: FileUploadProps) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<QueueItem[]>([])
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [windowDrag, setWindowDrag] = useState(false)
  const [overZone, setOverZone] = useState(0)
  const reduced = usePrefersReducedMotion()
  const baseId = useId()
  const hintId = `${baseId}-hint`
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const zoneRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  const nextIndex = useRef(0)
  const controllers = useRef(new Map<string, AbortController>())
  const previewUrls = useRef(new Map<string, string>())
  const wasBusy = useRef(false)

  // Latest callbacks, read from async upload code without re-running effects.
  const latest = useRef({ onUpload, onUploadSuccess, onUploadError, onComplete, uploadDelay, simulateFailure })
  useEffect(() => {
    latest.current = { onUpload, onUploadSuccess, onUploadError, onComplete, uploadDelay, simulateFailure }
  })

  const limit = multiple ? Math.max(1, maxFiles) : 1
  const counted = items.filter((item) => item.status !== 'rejected').length
  const isFull = counted >= limit

  const updateItem = useCallback(
    (id: string, patch: Partial<QueueItem>) =>
      setItems((prev) => prev.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, ...patch } : item))),
    [],
  )

  const runUpload = useCallback(
    (item: QueueItem) => {
      const controller = new AbortController()
      controllers.current.set(item.id, controller)
      const { signal } = controller
      const cb = latest.current

      const onProgress = (percent: number) => {
        if (!signal.aborted) updateItem(item.id, { progress: clampProgress(percent) })
      }
      const succeed = () => {
        if (signal.aborted) return
        controllers.current.delete(item.id)
        updateItem(item.id, { status: 'done', progress: 100 })
        latest.current.onUploadSuccess?.(item.file)
      }
      const fail = (reason: unknown) => {
        if (signal.aborted) return
        controllers.current.delete(item.id)
        const error = {
          message: reason instanceof Error && reason.message ? reason.message : 'Upload failed',
          code: 'UPLOAD_FAILED',
        }
        updateItem(item.id, { status: 'error', error })
        latest.current.onUploadError?.(error, item.file)
      }

      if (cb.onUpload) {
        const upload = cb.onUpload
        Promise.resolve()
          .then(() => upload(item.file, { onProgress, signal }))
          .then(succeed, fail)
        return
      }
      const shouldFail = cb.simulateFailure && item.attempts === 1 && item.index % 3 === 1
      simulateUpload({ onProgress, signal }, cb.uploadDelay, shouldFail).then(succeed, fail)
    },
    [updateItem],
  )

  // Scheduler: keep up to CONCURRENCY uploads in flight.
  useEffect(() => {
    const active = items.filter((item) => item.status === 'uploading').length
    const toStart = items
      .filter((item) => item.status === 'queued')
      .slice(0, Math.max(0, CONCURRENCY - active))
      .filter((item) => !controllers.current.has(item.id))
      .map((item) => ({ ...item, attempts: item.attempts + 1 }))
    if (!toStart.length) return
    const started = new Map(toStart.map((item) => [item.id, item]))
    setItems((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) => {
        const next = started.get(item.id)
        return next ? { ...next, status: 'uploading', progress: 0 } : item
      }),
    )
    for (const item of toStart) runUpload(item)
  }, [items, runUpload])

  // Settle: report once nothing is queued or in flight.
  useEffect(() => {
    const busy = items.some((item) => item.status === 'queued' || item.status === 'uploading')
    // Cancelling everything clears the list; that is not a completion.
    if (wasBusy.current && !busy && items.length > 0) {
      latest.current.onComplete?.(items.filter((item) => item.status === 'done').map((item) => item.file))
    }
    wasBusy.current = busy
  }, [items])

  // Abort uploads and free previews on unmount.
  useEffect(() => {
    const ctrl = controllers.current
    const urls = previewUrls.current
    return () => {
      for (const controller of ctrl.values()) controller.abort()
      ctrl.clear()
      for (const url of urls.values()) URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
      urls.clear()
    }
  }, [])

  // A file dragged anywhere over the window wakes the drop zone, and a drop that misses it does not
  // make the browser navigate away to the file.
  useEffect(() => {
    let depth = 0
    const onEnter = (e: globalThis.DragEvent) => {
      if (!isFileDrag(e)) return
      depth += 1
      setWindowDrag(true)
    }
    const onLeave = (e: globalThis.DragEvent) => {
      if (!isFileDrag(e)) return
      depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1)
      if (depth === 0) setWindowDrag(false)
    }
    const onOver = (e: globalThis.DragEvent) => {
      if (isFileDrag(e)) e.preventDefault()
    }
    const onEnd = (e: globalThis.DragEvent) => {
      if (isFileDrag(e)) e.preventDefault()
      depth = 0
      setWindowDrag(false)
      setOverZone(0)
    }
    window.addEventListener('dragenter', onEnter)
    window.addEventListener('dragleave', onLeave)
    window.addEventListener('dragover', onOver)
    window.addEventListener('drop', onEnd)
    window.addEventListener('dragend', onEnd)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('dragenter', onEnter)
      window.removeEventListener('dragleave', onLeave)
      window.removeEventListener('dragover', onOver)
      window.removeEventListener('drop', onEnd)
      window.removeEventListener('dragend', onEnd)
    }
  }, [])

  const validate = useCallback(
    (file: File): FileError | null => {
      if (acceptedFileTypes.length && !acceptedFileTypes.some((type) => matchesAcceptedType(file, type))) {
        return { message: `Not ${describeAcceptedTypes(acceptedFileTypes)}`, code: 'INVALID_FILE_TYPE' }
      }
      if (file.size > maxFileSize) {
        return { message: `Larger than ${formatBytes(maxFileSize)}`, code: 'FILE_TOO_LARGE' }
      }
      return validateFile?.(file) ?? null
    },
    [acceptedFileTypes, maxFileSize, validateFile],
  )

  const addFiles = useCallback(
    (fileList: FileList | File[] | null) => {
      const files = Array.from(fileList ?? [])
      if (!files.length) return
      const { added, skipped } = buildItems(files, {
        room: Math.max(0, limit - counted),
        validate,
        nextId: () => {
          const index = nextIndex.current
          nextIndex.current += 1
          return { id: `${baseId}-${index}`, index }
        },
      })
      for (const item of added) {
        if (item.previewUrl) previewUrls.current.set(item.id, item.previewUrl)
        if (item.error) onUploadError?.(item.error, item.file)
      }
      setNotice(
        skipped ? `${skipped} ${skipped === 1 ? 'file was' : 'files were'} not added. The limit is ${limit}.` : null,
      )
      if (added.length) setItems((prev) => [...prev, ...added])
    },
    [baseId, counted, limit, onUploadError, validate],
  )

  const removeItem = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      controllers.current.get(id)?.abort()
      controllers.current.delete(id)
      const url = previewUrls.current.get(id)
      if (url) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
        previewUrls.current.delete(id)
      }
      const item = items.find((i) => i.id === id)
      setItems((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i.id !== id))
      setNotice(null)
      if (item) onFileRemove?.(item.file)
    },
    [items, onFileRemove],
  )

  // The clicked button leaves with its row, so focus returns to the drop zone instead of the page.
  const removeAndRefocus = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      removeItem(id)
      zoneRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    },
    [removeItem],
  )

  const clearAll = useCallback(() => {
    for (const item of items) removeItem(item.id)
    zoneRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
  }, [items, removeItem])

  const retryItem = useCallback(
    (id: string) => updateItem(id, { status: 'queued', progress: 0, error: undefined }),
    [updateItem],
  )

  const openPicker = () => {
    if (!isFull) inputRef.current?.click()
  }

  const handleInputChange = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    addFiles(e.target.files)
    e.target.value = ''
  }

  const handleZoneDrag = (e: DragEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (!isFileDrag(e)) return
    e.preventDefault()
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = isFull ? 'none' : 'copy'
    setOverZone(Math.max(1, countDraggedFiles(e.dataTransfer)))
  }

  const handleZoneLeave = (e: DragEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (e.relatedTarget instanceof Node && e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return
    setOverZone(0)
  }

  const handleZoneDrop = (e: DragEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setOverZone(0)
    setWindowDrag(false)
    if (!isFull) addFiles(e.dataTransfer.files)
  }

  const handlePaste = (e: ClipboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (e.clipboardData.files.length) {
      e.preventDefault()
      addFiles(e.clipboardData.files)
    }
  }

  const { done, failed, busy } = summarize(items)
  const { title, showBrowse, hint } = zoneCopy({
    isFull,
    overZone,
    windowDrag,
    multiple,
    limit,
    maxFileSize,
    acceptedFileTypes,
  })

  const armed = windowDrag && !isFull
  const over = overZone > 0 && !isFull

  return (
    <div className={cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-2 text-card-foreground shadow-xs', className)}>
      <button
        ref={zoneRef}
        type="button"
        aria-describedby={hintId}
        aria-disabled={isFull || undefined}
        className={cn(
          'group/zone flex w-full flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed px-4 py-6 text-center outline-none',
          !reduced && 'transition-colors duration-150 ease-out',
          'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
          isFull
            ? 'cursor-not-allowed border-border bg-muted/30'
            : 'cursor-pointer border-input bg-muted/40 hover:border-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/70 active:bg-muted',
          armed && 'border-muted-foreground bg-muted/70',
          over && 'border-solid border-foreground bg-muted',
        )}
        onClick={openPicker}
        onDragEnter={handleZoneDrag}
        onDragLeave={handleZoneLeave}
        onDragOver={handleZoneDrag}
        onDrop={handleZoneDrop}
        onPaste={handlePaste}
      >
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn(
            'flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border bg-card shadow-xs',
            !reduced && 'transition-colors duration-150',
            armed || over ? 'border-input text-foreground' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground',
          )}
        >
          <UploadIcon
            className={cn('size-4', !reduced && 'transition-[translate] duration-200 ease-out', (armed || over) && !reduced && '-translate-y-0.5')}
          />
        </span>
        <span className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <span className={cn('text-sm font-medium', !reduced && 'transition-colors duration-150', isFull ? 'text-muted-foreground' : 'text-foreground')}>
            {title}
            {showBrowse && (
              <span className="underline decoration-border underline-offset-[3px] group-hover/zone:decoration-foreground">
                browse
              </span>
            )}
          </span>
          <span id={hintId} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
            {hint}
          </span>
        </span>
      </button>

      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="file"
        aria-label="Choose files"
        accept={acceptedFileTypes.join(',') || undefined}
        className="hidden"
        multiple={multiple}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        tabIndex={-1}
      />

      {notice && (
        <p role="alert" className="mt-2 px-1 text-xs text-destructive">
          {notice}
        </p>
      )}

      <ul aria-label="Files" className="mt-1 px-1">
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          {items.map((item) => (
            <QueueRow key={item.id} item={item} reduced={reduced} onRemove={removeAndRefocus} onRetry={retryItem} />
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </ul>

      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {items.length > 0 && (
          <motion.div
            className="overflow-hidden"
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.2, ease: EASE_OUT }}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 pt-2 pb-0.5">
              <output aria-live="polite" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                <span className="text-foreground">{done}</span> of {items.length} uploaded
                {failed > 0 && <span className="text-destructive"> · {failed} failed</span>}
              </output>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="-mr-1 rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground outline-none transition-colors duration-150 hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                onClick={clearAll}
              >
                {busy ? 'Cancel all' : 'Clear'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { FileUpload } from '@/components/file-upload'

export default function FileUploadDemo() {
  const [uploaded, setUploaded] = useState<string[]>([])
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col items-center gap-4">
      {/* No onUpload: the component simulates every upload locally, nothing is sent anywhere. */}
      <FileUpload
        acceptedFileTypes={['image/*', '.pdf']}
        maxFileSize={10 * 1024 * 1024}
        maxFiles={4}
        uploadDelay={1800}
        simulateFailure
        onComplete={(files) => setUploaded(files.map((f) => f.name))}
      />
      <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        {uploaded.length ? (
          <>
            Finished: <span className="text-foreground">{uploaded.join(', ')}</span>
          </>
        ) : (
          'Pick an image or PDF. The first attempt of every third file fails so you can try Retry.'
        )}
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}
